name: Lemon Mayonnaise
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: ½ cup extra-virgin olive oil, divided

steps: Whisk together all ingredients except for oil in a large bowl.
One tbsp at a time, slowly drizzle in oil while continually and vigorously whisking. Do not stop whisking, or the mayonnaise may separate.
Keep refrigerated for up to 3 weeks in a nonreactive container.
